statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; DoD-delivery supply chain risks never accepted
Annual policy review
Annual CMMC Level 1 self-assessment of all 15 requirements
Affirm in SPRS only when every requirement is MET with evidence
Written, time-limited exceptions; none against FAR 52.204-21 while a Level 1 status is held
Sanctions for any future employee or helper
Sourcing rule: authorized sources for DoD orders and network devices
Check marketplace sellers and brokers before the first purchase
Receiving checks: OEM serial lookup, seal inspection, firmware hash; quarantine
Section 889 check of the true manufacturer on every DoD quote; clause substance on DoD-bound purchase orders
Call-back before a first payment or bank-detail change
Supplier and service provider list; annual SOC 2 review
Owner-started, watched remote support
Unique accounts; no shared credentials
MFA by authenticator app wherever offered
Unique passphrases in a password manager; no default passwords
Quarterly account review; same-day removal
Standard daily laptop account
Device lock after 5 minutes (phone 1 minute)
Sealed emergency access codes held by the owner's attorney
Monthly sign-in, forwarding rule, and payment-detail review
Three-level data classification
Restricted data, including FCI, only in approved locations
CUI stop rule: do not accept CUI; re-scope first
Named-people sharing; 30-day link expiry
Staging spreadsheets in cloud storage; backups with version history
Six-year retention of security and CMMC evidence
Device and returned-equipment sanitization with a record
Business-only Wi-Fi; quarterly router check; current firmware
Automatic updates and antivirus stay on
No posting about DoD work; photo check
Approved AI tool only, training off, no Restricted data
Garage and cabinet: lockbox key, yearly code change, escort, entry log
Annual security and anti-counterfeit training
Incident runbook with printed contact sheet
Same-day incident log with discovery or identification time
Report clocks: 1 business day (Section 889), 3 business days (Kaspersky), 2 business days (BPA)
No extortion payment without counsel and an OFAC check
Emergency sheet and agreement with the prime
